theorem: The 720 local trade directions are exactly the nonorthogonal edges of the 45-point GQ(4,2) minimum-vector carrier. The 360 minimum blockers map 8-to-1 to that carrier and the 2880 optimal near-ovoids map 64-to-1. Forty canonical 9-sets O_c recover W33 adjacency by intersection sizes 3 versus 1, and every optimal near-ovoid is parametrized by (a,c,m) with a~c and m in O_c minus O_a.
boundary: Finite incidence/group-action theorem only; no physical-state identification is implied.
